previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (size varies). A red(2) SOURCE shape with an adjacent MARKER pattern of color-4 (yellow) cells (a D4-ASYMMETRIC cluster so the match is unambiguous). 1-3 TARGET clusters elsewhere replicate that marker pattern (the red footprint left empty). Rule: wherever the marker pattern recurs, stamp the red shape at the matching offset; color-4 cells are preserved. The grid size, the red shape, the marker pattern, the source position and the targets' count/positions all vary freely (was a near-fixed layout giving ~4 distinct).

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent set of non-source candidate footprints, each paired with its squared-distance score from the source bounding-box origin.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Enumerate every red footprint induced by a complete D4 match of the source-adjacent yellow marker constellation.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Discard the source footprint, select the maximum-score candidate, erase unselected source red cells, and stamp only that selected footprint.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected location and red cells vary with the marker matches in the input; Stage B has no candidate or score to compare until Stage A has produced the complete candidate set.
